title: WorkflowConfig
description: Schema for ContextSmith workflow configuration files. Defines the state machine, phase ordering, validation gates, and execution parameters for orchestrated agent workflows.

workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow. Used in checkpoints and logs. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens or underscores.

version.description: Schema version. Must match the orchestrator's expected version.

domain.description: Domain category that determines which validators and references apply.

mode.description: Execution mode. Currently only 'phased-run' is supported.

harness.description: Which harness adapter to use. 'auto' = detect from environment, or a registered adapter name.

baseline.description: Baseline requirements that the orchestrator enforces.

overlay.description: Optional overlay that modifies the baseline workflow.

states.description: State machine definitions for each phase step. Keys are phase step names.

phase_order.description: Ordered list of phase step names that form the workflow.

validation.description: Global validation rules applied after phase execution.

artifact_schemas.description: Per-artifact schema overrides for markdown state artifacts. Keys are artifact filenames (e.g., STATUS.md, PLAN.md). Each value declares section overrides that extend or replace the base schemas from schemas/artifact_schemas.yaml.

required_steps.description: Steps that must be present in phase_order after overlay resolution.

required_gates.description: Gates that must pass before the workflow can complete.

required_files.description: Files that must exist in the task-state directory.

add_steps.description: Steps to insert into the phase order after specified anchor points.

remove_steps.description: Steps to remove from the phase order.

allow_remove_required.description: If true, the overlay can remove required steps. Requires --force flag at runtime.

notes.description: Human-readable notes about the overlay's purpose.

step.description: Name of the step to insert.

after.description: Anchor step name to insert after. Null = insert at beginning.

state.description: The canonical state machine state this phase corresponds to.

agent.description: Agent profile to use for this phase.

max_retries.description: Maximum retries before transitioning to blocked.

optional.description: If true, this step can be removed by overlay.

transitions.description: Valid exit transitions from this state.

expected_outputs.description: Files this phase is expected to produce.

inputs.description: Files this phase reads as input.

checkpoint_before_run.description: If true, write checkpoint before dispatching (in addition to after).

ralph_max_cycles.description: For ralph_critique states: max critique-revise cycles before forced advance.

validation_mode.description: Artifact validation strictness. strict=block on failure, relaxed=warn and pass, none=skip.

model_pin.description: Pin a specific model for this state. Passed through to harness adapter.

condition.description: Condition that triggers this transition. Common values: pass, fail, output_valid, output_invalid, max_retries, max_cycles_reached, unstructured, always.

target.description: Target state name, or special values: retry-same-state, blocked, done.

schema.description: Schema file path for phase contract validation (relative to project root).

required_checks.description: Checks to run after phase execution.

relaxed.description: If true, validation failures are reported but do not block advancement.

description.description: Description of what this workflow does.

extends.description: Base schema key from artifact_schemas.yaml to extend. Defaults to the artifact filename key (e.g., STATUS.md).

required_sections.description: Override required sections for this artifact. When extend_base is true (default), merged as union with base schema required_sections. When false, replaces base entirely.

optional_sections.description: Override optional sections for this artifact. When extend_base is true (default), merged as union with base schema optional_sections. When false, replaces base entirely.

additional_sections.description: Sections to add on top of base schema sections regardless of extend_base. Always merged as union — never removes base sections.

extend_base.description: If true, overridden sections are merged with base schema sections (union). If false, overrides completely replace the base.
